standing_commitments.regulates: Current published assessment work of Index must use the Profile/Methodology selected for the bounded Organization while Skills remains the procedure authority and Awesome consumes canonical Index results.
standing_commitments.s3_choice: Only a material current cross-S1 operating-commitment reconciliation that cannot be decided by the local S1 owners; bounded interim CONTINUE/REQUIRE_REPAIR/SET_CONSTRAINT without selecting/redefining Profile or Methodology.
standing_commitments.never: Changing selected Methodology/Profile is reserved above G1; ordinary version checks and local Index errors remain S1.

standing_commitments.regulates: Index remains the canonical evidence and grade owner; Awesome consumes its canonical relationships without independently editing assessments, while downstream publication obligations must remain mutually consistent.
standing_commitments.s3_choice: Only material present cross-S1 commitment or shared-constraint tradeoff that exceeds ordinary Index correctness and Awesome curation/repair; bounded interim CONTINUE/REQUIRE_REPAIR/SET_CONSTRAINT returned to an admitted affected S1 item.
standing_commitments.never: No Index grade veto/override, no Awesome editorial substitution, no blanket publication freeze or automatic human gate.
